name: 0000-MAIN
description: The 0000-MAIN paragraph orchestrates the high-level flow of the batch program by performing subparagraphs to open files, process transactions, and close files, displaying a message during execution and terminating the program gracefully.

algorithm.details: Iterate through 2000-PROCESS-TXNS to process transactions until condition met.
Output runtime status or message to console.

sideEffects.description: Files accessed during processing are opened, potentially updated, and closed.
